description: Cheap tier - a single Polymarket outcome's live top-of-book bid/ask spread as a percentage of mid_price. Not a liquidity or executability measure (use prediction.exit_capacity_audit/order_split_guide for that). Accepts either a raw token_id or a market_slug (+ outcome) to resolve it automatically - exact slug only, no fuzzy keyword search. Paid in USDC on Base.

market_slug.description: Exact Polymarket market slug, used to resolve token_id automatically.

outcome.description: "yes" (default) or "no" - which side to resolve when using market_slug.

token_id.description: The outcome's CLOB token_id / asset_id, if already known.

name: prediction.bid_ask_spread_pct
